item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
## 0.1.0 — 2026-10-20
### Features
- **reader:** show notes in a popover, images in a larger sheet and an external link's address before opening it - **reader:** open notes and images in place and confirm external links before opening them - **reader:** add the appearance popover and text size commands - **reader:** report note and image clicks and return focus to a note's reference - **reader:** restore and save the reading appearance per edition - **bridge:** accept note and image links within the envelope's caps - **bridge:** apply font, margins and a paper tone that ignores the app's appearance - **bookkit:** decode a listed image for a bounded larger view - **bookkit:** read a note's paragraphs by its id - **store:** keep a reading appearance per edition - **reader:** describe font, margins and paper tone in the reading appearance - **settings:** add a keyless local server connection with ollama and lm studio presets - **providers:** label a local server on this mac only when ollama lists every model as local - **reader:** bookmark the active passage from the toolbar, menu and sidebar - **settings:** connect an anthropic api key beside the openai-compatible one - **providers:** stream replies over the anthropic messages api - **store:** keep bookmarks with their chapter and list them in book order - **reader:** save the reading place as the reader reads and reopen there - **store:** save and read a session's resume and furthest places - **reader:** hide the contents in Focus and restore them on exit - **reader:** activate passages by click and from the Reading menu - **bridge:** mark the active passage with a margin indicator - **reader:** add the Go menu with Back and chapter commands - **reader:** show the contents tree in the sidebar - **reader:** navigate by contents and internal links with Back - **bookkit:** find the chapter and segment a link or anchor lands on - **bookkit:** outline the contents tree with each entry's chapter - **reader:** render a chapter in the reading window - **library:** find the book file of a reading session - **bridge:** load a chapter composed ahead of time - **store:** find the primary edition of a reading session - **alignment:** trust structural links from score 0.5 - **settings:** give every request error a message and next step - **settings:** list apple intelligence with its availability - **providers:** add the apple intelligence on-device connection - **translation:** host the system download consent for a language pair - **providers:** translate on this Mac with Apple Translation in batches of 16 - **release:** refuse to run from the disk image or when translocated - **settings:** check for updates with sparkle from a general tab - **settings:** connect an OpenAI-compatible API key with its address, model and Disconnect - **providers:** stream Responses or Chat Completions over URLSession after probing the endpoint and its models - **providers:** refuse a request for an unserved model, an unsupported language or too small a context before sending - **providers:** parse server-sent events into text, usage and mapped errors - **settings:** add a Privacy tab to turn off usage data sharing - **analytics:** record imports by size bucket and import failures by error token - **analytics:** record app launched and report Debug builds to PostHog EU - **analytics:** set up the SDK only while sharing is on - **analytics:** add AnalyticsService with a PostHog adapter and a fake - **analytics:** add closed AnalyticsEvent cases with pinned tokens - **workflows:** add the app-wide job coordinator - **store:** persist jobs and job items in a v2-jobs migration - **workflows:** add job limits, retry policy and fair scheduling order - **workflows:** add job contracts and the job transition reducer - **library:** add File > Open and Open Recent with Clear Menu - **library:** show covers or a list, import by Open Book and drop, and open a reading window - **library:** copy picked and dropped books under their security scope - **library:** declare EPUB books as a viewer document type - **library:** explain each import failure in its own message - **providers:** record item count and duration for every request - **library:** open the store under Application Support at launch and observe the library - **library:** observe recent sessions and each book's progress in the store - **library:** make a cover thumbnail once at import and store its path - **alignment:** measure precision and recall per link type - **alignment:** align paragraphs structurally around manual anchors - **alignment:** pair chapter ranges by titles, order, lengths and anchors - **alignment:** add anchor evidence and a banded monotonic aligner with affine gaps - **library:** read an EPUB's cover image through BookKit - **reader:** add the Dev-only two-pane harness and keep Look Up and Translate in the context menu - **bridge:** add the reading surface contract and a WebKit surface driven by bridge.js - **settings:** add a settings window with a connections tab - **library:** own the import task in LibraryManager and cancel it on close - **settings:** store connection credentials in the keychain - **library:** import books through a journal that recovers interrupted imports on launch - **settings:** disclose the text sent and its processing location before first use - **store:** journal imports, commit an edition's catalog in one transaction and reuse its session - **providers:** define connection and request contracts with a conformance suite - **bookkit:** return a composed chapter's segments with its sections - **bridge:** validate bridge messages and serve chapters from tandem-book: with a CSP header - **bookkit:** compose a chapter's resource ranges into sanitized sections - **store:** create the database, migrations, backups and library repository - **workflows:** decide resume, furthest and back positions in a pure reducer - **bookkit:** extract chapters, segments and locators - **model:** name the first extraction version - **bookkit:** sanitize resources and split oversized ones into render chunks - **bookkit:** parse the EPUB container, package and navigation - **library:** open the library window with its empty state - **model:** add the identity and locator contracts
### Bug Fixes
- **bridge:** open a focused image once while return or space is held - **bookkit:** offer an image's larger view by the type the book lists for it - **reader:** mark a chapter read on as furthest once the reader stays past the dwell - **reader:** move the resume place with next and previous passage - **bridge:** keep a text column in a narrow pane at the largest text and widest margins - **bridge:** keep a visible active passage in place when the typography changes - **reader:** close a note when the pane's width or the reading appearance changes - **bridge:** shorten an image description between characters and read svg link targets - **reader:** open a described book image larger from the keyboard - **bookkit:** preview only png, jpeg, gif and webp images under a pixel cap - **reader:** finish saving the reading appearance when its window closes - **reader:** close a note from the old chapter when the next chapter shows - **reader:** keep a note that is still loading closed once the reader scrolls - **reader:** never offer an external link too long to show in full - **store:** open an appearance stored with fewer fields in the standard values - **reader:** close only the note, image or link a dismissal names - **reader:** follow a note link that has no note behind it, as any link - **bookkit:** treat a link target longer than a note as no note - **reader:** keep an image closed when a click ends a text selection - **bookkit:** hold each visited element while its span is keyed by identity - **bookkit:** never split links or quotations, and name what isn't split in ADR-0024 - **bookkit:** let any element not descended into reset the line break - **bookkit:** attach an inline clone to a piece only once it holds text - **reader:** check a bookmark's place exactly before showing it - **reader:** say when a bookmark's place can't be found - **reader:** keep the lost-place notice until the reader dismisses it - **reader:** withdraw only the Undo of a bookmark write that failed - **bridge:** treat only the scroll the bridge caused as its own - **bookkit:** split line-marked paragraphs inside inline elements, cloning each element per piece - **ci:** keep a process name with spaces in one column of the benchmark samples - **reader:** hold the undo manager weakly and withdraw undo when a bookmark write fails - **reader:** count going through bookmarks in a row as one Back step - **settings:** offer choose a model in the picker when no model is selected - **settings:** let other address replace a chosen local server preset - **reader:** keep the quit save armed until a closed window's last save lands - **reader:** write a new furthest place on quit even when the resume place is saved - **workflows:** restart the furthest-place dwell on chapter steps and further browsing - **bridge:** stop reporting the bridge's own re-anchoring as the reader scrolling - **reader:** drop a Back place that can no longer be found - **reader:** take a link's Back origin once its destination is known - **reader:** say when the saved place can't be found and keep it until the reader reads - **reader:** keep saving progress when the saved place can't be read - **providers:** report an oversized request as too long for the model - **reader:** start bookmarks as soon as the book opens - **settings:** refuse a connection address that carries credentials, a query or a fragment - **settings:** clear a selected model the server stopped offering and ask the reader to choose - **reader:** record direct reading only from passages in view - **providers:** budget the reply within the context window left after the input - **alignment:** ignore tokens that recur across chapters of both editions when pairing chapters - **providers:** confirm local routing again each session instead of trusting a stored confirmation - **bookkit:** place a later piece at its first element so a boundary inside it leaves earlier pieces behind - **bookkit:** track whether a piece has text instead of re-reading it at each indent - **bookkit:** resolve chapter boundaries through the piece wrappers of a split block - **providers:** keep the system prompt ahead of the passages in every messages body - **reader:** give contents rows stable ids, one selected row and expanded parents - **reader:** reveal a passage only when it's cut off and never after the activation is replaced - **reader:** announce the active passage's first sentence in the book's language - **reader:** resolve a link before replacing the current navigation and pop Back only on arrival - **reader:** keep the Back origin through unfinished jumps and end contents browsing on scroll - **alignment:** cap the chapter length cost so a long companion-only appendix can't erase the pairs - **bridge:** send same-chapter fragment links through the reader so Back returns - **alignment:** guide the band only by anchor chains of five or more - **alignment:** weigh one-sided names lightly so the Verne chapters pair - **reader:** count browsing through the contents as one Back step - **bookkit:** split a block at each line break before an ideographic space - **alignment:** link the japanese title 羅生門 to rashōmon in the rashomon gold - **alignment:** define a trusted group as linked on both sides and at the threshold - **perf:** cancel the follower on every exit and require the companion position - **perf:** warn only about foreground apps that open during a benchmark run - **perf:** warn when apps open during a benchmark run and could add WebKit workers - **perf:** start the companion follower once tracing records and fail the benchmark when it stops - **perf:** keep the benchmark lane going when the run file has no checker libraries to remove - **perf:** trace only the tandem dev process this run started - **perf:** reap the benchmark run and print its summary when a step fails - **perf:** record the display refresh rate in the machine manifest - **perf:** start scrolling the follow benchmark only once the hitch trace records - **perf:** run benchmarks without coverage or runtime checkers - **providers:** leave room for the answer when admitting an apple intelligence request - **alignment:** take the chapter length ratio over the span between the first and last anchor pairs - **translation:** format provider error messages in a given locale so tests can pin en_US - **translation:** tell apart languages that differ only in script when asking for a download - **providers:** name the languages to download for Apple Translation instead of a host - **providers:** blame the language pair, not the target, when Apple Translation can't pair them - **alignment:** count each reference link at most once when measuring - **translation:** report a declined download as not prepared and drop cancelled or superseded preparations - **settings:** drop string keys duplicated by the merge and restore their order - **settings:** drop string keys duplicated by the merge - **release:** read a multiline notarization result - **release:** give distribute time for two notarization waits - **alignment:** estimate the chapter length ratio from anchor pairs, not totals - **release:** drop the push token before the linear cli runs - **release:** reuse a published zip before archiving or notarizing again - **release:** let a rerun on an updated toolchain keep the published manifest - **release:** run a manual release only from main - **release:** ship a labeled merge whose release run was superseded - **settings:** show a custom address again after a relaunch - **settings:** keep the newest key when an older connect attempt saves late - **providers:** return a finished reply and close its connection even if the server leaves it open - **providers:** report an unrecognised client error as a failed request - **providers:** fail a reply cut short by its token limit or a content filter - **providers:** refuse redirects so book text never reaches another host - **harness:** save the position a load ends at, not the one it asked for - **bridge:** keep the load's position when a deferred reveal names another chapter - **bridge:** reject a mid-load reveal older than the load - **harness:** save a pane after every load and programmatic reveal without cancelling its load - **bridge:** clear the selection when the new one can't be mapped to segments - **bridge:** apply font size as zoom and line height over the book's own sizes - **bridge:** hold a reveal that arrives mid-load until the load is ready - **alignment:** ignore anchor chains too short to guide the band - **store:** keep job items when cached segments are pruned - **alignment:** spend at most half the matrix on bands and solve the full matrix at most once - **settings:** say what usage data carries besides counts and choices - **analytics:** send each event as it is recorded so none flush after an opt-out - **analytics:** stop PostHog locating the Mac from its IP address - **workflows:** restore a job's state when saving it fails - **workflows:** ignore a refill error from a superseded run - **store:** let a job that is being cancelled be requested again - **workflows:** fail a job whose completion can't be saved - **library:** show the library when a reading window receives a book to open - **library:** route Finder opens through reading windows and open each requested window once - **library:** show each import failure in a batch in turn - **library:** find EPUB 2 covers named by the cover meta - **library:** open a reading window only when a single book is imported - **library:** launch the UI test against a temporary library - **library:** skip the cover thumbnail when the image has too many pixels to decode - **alignment:** keep evaluated cells within the full matrix - **alignment:** seed the length ratio from anchor pairs and refine it until stable - **alignment:** guide the band by an anchor chain and widen it until the cost settles - **library:** keep a managed copy recovery can't read yet and retry it next launch - **library:** reject a directory or oversized source before copying it - **providers:** fail a cancelled send instead of returning a partial result - **providers:** record every translation request - **bookkit:** point relative style URLs at their resource with strictly encoded paths - **library:** clear the last import failure when a new import starts - **library:** start recovery when LibraryManager is created so every import waits for it - **library:** let LibraryManager deinit mid-import so closing cancels it - **library:** replay each interrupted import on its own and always sweep staging - **library:** discard a managed copy moved before the journal recorded the move - **library:** finish an import's cleanup after it is cancelled and report the cancel - **bookkit:** keep the body's class and style on a composed section - **library:** copy a symlinked source's bytes so the managed copy stands alone - **bookkit:** keep a stamped parent's own text with the chapter that owns its segment - **bookkit:** point relative style URLs at their resource when composing a chapter - **settings:** probe connection availability concurrently - **settings:** retry the update when a concurrent first save added the credential - **providers:** reach providers only through the request gate - **store:** verify a backup before giving it a backup name - **store:** order the in-memory library like the database - **store:** release a deleted companion instead of failing the session check - **workflows:** commit a completed save even after reading moves on - **bookkit:** drop a style value that still reaches a remote URL after cleaning - **bookkit:** saturate continued list numbers and mark every piece of a split segment - **bookkit:** hide the marker on continued pieces of a split list item - **bookkit:** add no word break for inline math in a parent's text - **bookkit:** split oversized mixed-content wrappers and stamp only their first piece - **bookkit:** keep a word break where a child segment sat in its parent's text - **bookkit:** keep an end-of-segment offset when creating a locator - **bookkit:** continue ordered-list numbering in later render chunks - **bookkit:** skip content the sanitizer removes when extracting segments - **bookkit:** keep a parent's own text beside its child segments - **bookkit:** decode CSS escapes to a fixed point and check url() only after URL attributes - **bookkit:** serialize served documents as XML so SVG keeps its case - **bookkit:** recompute progression when re-anchoring - **bookkit:** repeat oversized wrappers around each chunk and never split a segment - **bookkit:** mark segments that hold only code as not translatable - **bookkit:** index ids inside tables, pre and math to their segment - **bookkit:** remove ping attributes - **bookkit:** remove SVG animation and remote url() in presentation attributes - **bookkit:** allow external hrefs only on links - **bookkit:** sanitize each srcset candidate on its own - **bookkit:** decode CSS escapes and drop every non-local url() and image-set() - **bookkit:** verify each entry's CRC and size after extracting - **bookkit:** compare the compression ratio without rounding down - **bookkit:** count every zip entry, including repeated names - **bookkit:** reject internal entity declarations before parsing - **ci:** don't take an argument label named default for an escape hatch - **ci:** catch tag-pinned actions behind quoted keys and flow mappings - **model:** reject an href whose first segment holds a colon - **ci:** fail the toolchain check when a probe exits nonzero
### Performance
- **bookkit:** reuse a bounded set of opened archives for resource reads
### Reverts
- **docs:** drop the restated segment storage line, already in §6 and the import paragraph - **alignment:** take the chapter length ratio from totals again - **alignment:** estimate the chapter length ratio from totals again - **settings:** undo the duplicate key removal that left the catalog unsorted - **ci:** drop the package resolution retry
